18.convention: Labels of weight class t are the t-subsets of range(m) in lexicographic order; row (t,a,b,c) has A = S0(a) + K2 - S2(c), B = K0 - S0(a) + S1(b), C = K1 - S1(b) + S2(c), with K_j the coordinates of kind j and S_j the label subset placed on K_j.
